data.title: test_mcp_tools.py — MCP tool layer test coverage
data.summary: New tests/test_mcp_tools.py covering all 5 new tools + note-ID fix + discovery fallback. Target: ≥25 cases passing in <0.5s. Same state_root fixture pattern as test_mcp_store.py.

sections.body: All tests use: state_root(tmp_path, monkeypatch) fixture that sets RECKON_STATE_ROOT=str(tmp_path) and reloads reckon._store (same pattern as test_mcp_store.py). Functions under test are imported from reckon.mcp directly (_list_followups, _list_questions, etc.). For _list_projects: additional monkeypatch replaces Path.home() with tmp_path so ~/docs-server/mounts.json resolves to tmp_path/docs-server/mounts.json. For discovery fallback: writes a minimal HTML fixture to tmp_path/docs/my-plan.html with the two required meta tags.

25 test functions grouped by tool: list_followups (5 tests), list_questions (3 tests), resolve_question (3 tests), add_research (3 tests), list_projects (3 tests), list_plans discovery fallback (2 tests), note-ID fix (2 tests), plus 4 regression tests re-running the 4 most important test_mcp_store.py scenarios to confirm no store regressions. All must pass in < 0.5s total (no I/O waits beyond tmp file writes).

uv run pytest tests/ -q --tb=short. Expected output: ≥33 passed (8 original store tests + ≥25 new tool tests), 0 failed. If any test references mcp.py functions not yet added, it will fail with ImportError or AttributeError — fix by adding the missing function first.
